name: refusal-then-success
why: `stop_reason: refusal`, with no content at all — checked before `content` is read. Retried once, then it succeeds.

provenance.why_not_recorded: A refusal followed by a success has never been observed. The live recording refused the same bytes twice with an identical `stop_details`, which is what a content-policy decision on fixed input should do. This fixture models the retry the code performs, not a sequence the API has been seen to produce.
